title: The Best Man
cn: 第 1 集 · 最佳男人
novel: Barney [[prepared|prepare]] for his wedding to a mystery bride. He felt [[nervous|nervous]] but also [[excited|excited]]. Ted stood beside him as his best man. They [[reminisced|reminisce]] about old memories together. Barney remembered Punchy's wedding, where everything went wrong in a funny way. At that wedding, Marshall and Lily [[announced|announce]] that they were [[expecting|expect]] a baby. Everyone was [[surprised|surprised]] and happy for them. Ted tried to [[calm|calm]] Barney down because he was shaking with worry. He told Barney that everything would be fine. Barney worried about whether he was making the right choice. Ted [[assured|assure]] him that [[marriage|marriage]] was a wonderful thing. Meanwhile, Marshall was very [[protective|protective]] of Lily during her [[pregnancy|pregnancy]]. He followed her everywhere and tried to help her with every little thing. Lily found it [[amusing|amusing]] but also a little [[annoying|annoying]]. Robin was [[dealing|deal]] with her own [[emotions|emotion]] about Barney's wedding. She tried to [[hide|hide]] her true feelings from everyone. The whole gang [[gathered|gather]] together to support Barney on his big day. They all wanted to make sure everything was [[perfect|perfect]]. Barney took a deep breath and smiled. He knew his friends would always be there for him.

announce.en: to tell people about something officially

expect.en: to think or believe something will happen

assure.en: to tell someone something is true

marriage.en: the legal relationship between two people

deal.en: to handle a situation or problem

emotion.en: a strong feeling such as love or fear

gather.en: to come together in one place
